source.title: Running Frontier-Class AI Models Across 8 NVIDIA DGX Spark Nodes

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete NVIDIA technical article, eight-node architecture, one-terabyte memory configuration, GLM 5.3 deployment, switch and ring results, RoCE tuning, throughput tables and stated topology limitations.

articles.selection_reason: Extends inference operations coverage from scheduling policy to a measured desktop-scale distributed serving configuration.

source.title: Introducing Rerank 5: precise, efficient enterprise document retrieval

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete Cohere announcement, Pro and Fast tiers, Context Focus behavior, evaluation methodology, 39-of-46 claim, multilingual and PDF results, throughput measurement, serving options and publisher-evidence limitations.

articles.selection_reason: Updates the evidence-retrieval theme with a different publisher and a passage-return mechanism suitable for controlled context-budget testing.

source.title: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete OpenAI report, whole-brain CRISPR dataset, distributed-agent architecture, 32-minute run, literature coverage comparison, expert preference evaluation, open reasoning atlas and explicit need for laboratory validation.

articles.selection_reason: Provides a knowledge-work case where agent scale expands literature synthesis while domain experts retain responsibility for interpretation.

source.title: Microsoft empowers more than 330,000 Volkswagen Group employees with Copilot

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete Microsoft Source case study, access and monthly-use figures, 26,000 active agents, phased functional rollout, planned Fabric foundation, named use cases and absence of independently measured outcome evidence.

articles.selection_reason: Adds large-scale adoption evidence while keeping access and activity separate from independently verified quality or productivity outcomes.

source.title: ServiceNow delivers industry-first personal enterprise agent and policy enforcement with NVIDIA, extending AI governance across software and silicon

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete ServiceNow release, Arc availability, cross-application workflow, planning behavior, Control Tower and OpenShell controls, Mac and Windows timing, future AI Passport details and forward-looking statement limitations.

articles.selection_reason: Extends consumer-agent permission coverage into governed workplace coordination across ordinary communication tools.

source.title: AI agent skills: Beyond the platform

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete Metis Strategy article, SKILL.md structure, description quality, freedom-versus-fragility guidance, supporting assets, evaluation against baselines, version ownership, registry governance, curator role and portability cautions.

articles.selection_reason: Materially updates reusable-Skills coverage with an organization-level authoring, evaluation and governance procedure beyond one product interface.

limitations: All benchmark, adoption and product claims are labeled as publisher-reported unless independent evidence is explicitly identified.
The Volkswagen case supplies access and activity measures, not independent productivity or quality outcomes.
The biological workflow generates hypotheses that require expert and laboratory validation.
